title: Methods and open-source toolkit for analyzing and visualizing challenge results
mechanism: Bootstrap ranking stability, significance maps and blob plots for ranking many algorithms on per-case scores.
adaptation: Rank benchmark methods by per-cell scores on the sealed test plus E1. Publish rank intervals and call methods tied when their ranks flip often.
min_experiment: With 5 or more suite methods: 1000 bootstrap resamples over cells, Kendall tau, and pairwise significance. Methods whose ranks swap in more than 30% of resamples are reported as tied.
evidence: R: toolkit used for biomedical challenge reporting (challengeR R package).

alt_notes.adaptation: Rank the benchmark method suite per metric with bootstrap over cells (modules for E1) and publish stability plots.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: bootstrap ranks of the method suite. Kill: reporting only (R install needs user OK).
